title: Print Echo
description: Fixed ink impressions turn with music and make brief printing strokes at drum beats and rises in musical dynamics, then settle back.

parameters.label: Echo Distance
parameters.description: Spacing of fainter complete impressions along the image contours.

parameters.label: Ink Pressure
parameters.description: Ink coverage within the source-derived printing screen.

parameters.label: Registration
parameters.description: Continuous misalignment between the complete colored printing plates.

parameters.label: Rose Ink
parameters.description: Warm ink that overlaps with the cyan impression.

parameters.label: Screen Detail
parameters.description: Strength of the fixed printing screen and paper grain.

parameters.label: Drift
parameters.description: Slow continuous impression drift; low frequencies gently vary its speed.

parameters.label: Beat Push
parameters.description: Push the two complete ink impressions apart without changing their ink or exposure.

parameters.label: Screen Density
parameters.description: Spacing of the printed halftone screen.

parameters.label: Turn
parameters.description: Rotation speed of the separation direction; the music advances the angle continuously.

parameters.label: Phrase Push
parameters.description: Brief printing strokes at rises in musical dynamics; sustained notes settle back.

provenance.prompt_summary: Fixed ink impressions turn with music and make brief printing strokes at drum beats and rises in musical dynamics, then settle back.
